question: At present, calculate for the player's age who have a sprint speed of no less than 97 between 2013 to 2015.
predicted_sql: SELECT CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(T.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_api_id, Player.birthday FROM Player_Attributes INNER JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Player_Attributes.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015) AS T
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT DATETIME() - T2.birthday age FROM Player_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',t1.`date`) >= '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y',t1.`date`) <= '2015' AND t1.sprint_speed >= 97
